video_title: Best for Warriors Fans to be "Patient" — Marc Spears

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors were not confident about landing LeBron James in free agency
quotes.excerpt: About two weeks before, I got the sense that the Warriors weren't confident that it was going to happen.
quotes.quote: About two weeks before, I got the sense that the Warriors weren't confident that it was going to happen. They were expecting LeBron to go to the Eastern Conference. I was getting fooled by the tea leaves, hearing them talking about his 11-year-old daughter and every time she leaves, she's like, 'Daddy, I want to come with you.' So to me, from a personal standpoint, Golden State made a lot of sense.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Nolan Richardson's philosophy on limiting superstars on a single team
quotes.excerpt: Nolan Richardson told me that the key to his success was that he never had more than three superstars.
quotes.quote: I covered Nolan Richardson, and Nolan Richardson told me that the key to his success was that he never had more than three superstars on the team. He said because you just need other people to do other things. You need somebody to play point, need somebody to defend, need somebody to rebound, need somebody to do the dirty work, and he would pattern his teams around three stars. Four is a lot, five is new territory.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' best chance for roster improvement is the trade deadline
quotes.excerpt: Maybe the creativity for them is at the trade deadline. Draymond doesn't have a no-trade clause anymore.
quotes.quote: Maybe the creativity for them is at the trade deadline. Draymond doesn't have a no-trade clause anymore. Jimmy Butler is expected to be healthy at that point, and maybe he could be used to trade for something else. I expect them to take care of staff and try to get Steph his long-term deal.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan would be a good fit for the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I would like DeMar in a Warriors uniform. It keeps him in California, which I know is very important.
quotes.quote: I would like DeMar in a Warriors uniform. It keeps him in California, which I know is very important to him. I don't know that the Warriors are trying to get him, but to me, it kind of helps keep things afloat until Jimmy gets back, and then you figure the rest out later.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Lacob wants to prove he can win post-Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: Joe Lacob is very activated by the idea of showing everybody that he can still put together a winner.
quotes.quote: There have been a couple comments made by reporters that sort of suggest that Joe Lacob is very activated by the idea of showing everybody that he can still put together a winner in the post-Steph era. And that's great, but at the same time, it makes it feel like there's a slight dismissiveness of now.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors fans should appreciate the Steph Curry era while it lasts
quotes.excerpt: I milked the Steph Curry train until it's dry. You got people that couldn't even be LeBron James fans.
quotes.quote: I milked the Steph Curry train until it's dry. You got people that couldn't even be LeBron James fans, so they were Kobe Bryant fans. They were happy to see LeBron go because they were Kobe Bryant fans, right? And I, as long as Steph can play a move, I think you just try to figure it out around him.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors should not hold off on a Steph Curry extension
quotes.excerpt: If they pay him that much money now, how much you think he bringing in? Probably tenfold.
quotes.quote: If they pay him that much money now, how much you think he bringing in? Probably tenfold. My point is, if they move him tomorrow, how much money they are about to lose? I'm not talking about losing Luka Doncic and what that did to them. You think they're losing some season ticket holders now? Watch 30 go somewhere else.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading for better talent is more realistic in February
quotes.excerpt: The ability to trade for better talent is available in February than it is now.
quotes.quote: The ability to trade for better talent is available in February than it is now. And you have expiring contracts, and teams that are like, 'You know what? Our team's trash, we're going to get rid of this guy,' and then that's when you can pounce. So let's see what Dunleavy's about.
